arguments.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: a complete run-start animation sprite sheet for a 2D fighting game. Generate 8 genuinely different, consecutive full-body KH2 Sora drawings arranged in a regular 4-column by 2-row sheet, equal square cells, reading left to right then next row. Transparent background. No labels, numbers, grid lines, ground marks, trails or effects. Reference image1 defines the approved smooth clean linework, rich cel shading, face/hair proportions, standard KH2 black/silver jacket, yellow straps, red waist cloth, baggy shorts and chunky black/yellow/red boots. Reference image2 defines the final far-arm shoulder-carry placement, not its canvas zoom. Reference image3 is weapon/carry construction only; do not copy its KHIV costume. Fixed right-facing three-quarter camera, equal character scale, consistent planted sole baseline and safe full-weapon margins in every cell. Draw each pose anatomically; no scaled/translated copies or mirrored stride substitutes. Frame0 is the low two-hand approved idle;1 slight knee/hip compression;2 near/front hand releases beside guard while far hand alone grips;3 far wrist and entire weapon lift together toward lower chest;4 nearly upright weapon and raised far elbow;5 rotate the rigid weapon clockwise into carry over the FAR holding arm's same shoulder, raised gold guard/gripping hand screen-left of the head, silver shaft passing behind hair/head and extending screen-right with slight foreground tip;6 forward lean and first toe push-off, near empty arm counter-swings;7 first right-facing running precontact matching the carry in image2. Use small continuous shoulder/elbow/wrist/pelvis/head changes between consecutive drawings. Exactly two complete arms/hands in every pose. Kingdom Key is ONE rigid connected object of identical physical length/design: black handle through center of gold guard, blue collar and straight silver shaft collinear with handle, same three-tooth crown/rounded cutouts, pommel chain attached and trailing slightly. Weapon and gripping wrist move together; hair/head correctly occlude the shaft in final carry. No missing blades, disconnected handles, upside-down grips, changing teeth, bent shafts or glove gears. Finish every drawing to the approved idle's art quality. This is original newly drawn animation artwork, not frames extracted from any game.
